title: COMP-MCCAA/07/2023 – Merger between Joinwell Limited/ F.X.Borg Furniture Limited/ Econetique Limited/ The Bath Concept Limited
text:
OFFICE FOR COMPETITION
15 May 2023
COMP-MCCAA/07/2023- Merger between Joinwell Limited/ F.X.Borg Furniture Limited/
Econetique Limited/ The Bath Concept Limited.
Decision on the proposed merger in terms of regulations 6(1)(ii) of the Control of
Concentrations Regulations (LN 294 of 2002 as subsequently amended)
The Office for Competition,
Having considered the notification filed on 19 April 2023 pursuant to Regulation 5 of the
Control of Concentrations Regulations,
Having considered the provisions of the Control of Concentrations Regulations,
Having considered Commission Notice on a simplified procedure for treatment of certain
concentrations under Regulation (EC) No 139/2004
Facts
1. On 19 April 2023, the Office for Competition (“the Office”) received a notification
of a proposed concentration pursuant to Regulation 5 of the Control of
Concentrations Regulations (“Regulations”) of the merger between Joinwell Limited
and FXB Investments Limited.
2. The notification was filed and accepted on Wednesday 19 April 2023 as a complete
notification and was notified to the public through a notice that appeared in The
Times of Malta, the Government Gazzette (No. 21,044) and on the Malta
Competition and Consumer Affairs Authority’s website on Tuesday 25 April 20231.
Members of the public were also invited to submit third-party objections by 2 May
2023. No third-party objections were received by the Office.
1 Notification of Concentration < https://www.mccaa.org.mt/Section/Content?contentId=8781 > last accessed 15
May 2023.
1

Parties
3. Joinwell Limited (“Joinwell”), with registration number C27929, is a limited liability
company incorporated in Malta in 1947. Its registered address is Mill Street, Central
Business District, Qormi, CBD 5090. During 2020, Joinwell generated a turnover of
[✄]. Joinwell imports premium furniture brands from Europe focusing on kitchens,
bedrooms, and bespoke manufacturing.
4. FXB Investments Limited (“FXB”), with registration number C66210, is a limited
liability company incorporated in Malta. Its registered address is Xewkija Industrial
Estate, Xewkija (Gozo), Malta. During 2020, FXB generated a turnover of [✄]. FXB is a
Maltese furniture group involved in the manufacturing and retailing of domestic and
contract furniture.
5. Three (3) of FXB’s subsidiary companies are also part of the proposed merger
transaction. Specifically:
a) F.X. Borg Furniture Limited (C2214): The company manufactures furniture for
the local domestic market and delivers turnkey furniture contracts in the
hotel, office, hospital, and other sectors. It manufactures furniture in two
plants situated in Xewkija, Gozo, and San Gwann, Malta.
b) Econetique Limited (C46843): The company offers energy preservation
solutions to commercial and domestic projects alike. Econetique offers end-
to-end services of heat conservation, turbine installations, photovoltaic
systems, led lighting solutions and much more.
c) The Bath Concept Limited (C85621): The company is in part owned by FXB
(50%) and in part by Infinite Sunlight Limited (C52600) (50%). The 50% share
capital currently owned by FXB is part of the proposed transaction. The Bath
Concept Limited trades as “WaterArt” and sells at wholesale level and at
retail level, sanitaryware, bathroom tiles, water fittings, and fireplaces and
stoves under the “WaterArt” brand.
6. Joinwell and FXB shall together be referred as the “Notifying Parties” or “the Parties”.
2

Transaction
7. Pursuant to the Memorandum of Understanding (“MOU”) signed on 25 January 2023, the
proposed transaction involves the merger of Joinwell and the shares held by FXB in 3
undertakings: (i) F.X. Borg Furniture Limited (ii) Econetique Limited; and (iii) The Bath Concept
Limited (collectively referred to as the “FXB Investment Assets”); into a new limited liability
company in Malta (the “New HoldCo”). Thus, the ultimate beneficial owners of the New HoldCo
will be: [✄] (the “Proposed Transaction”).
8. As a result of the Proposed Concentration, the New HoldCo will hold: i) 100% of the share capital
in Joinwell, ii) 100% of the share capital in F.X. Borg Furniture Limited, iii) 100% of the share
capital in Econetique Limited and iv) 50% of the share capital in The Bath Concept Limited.
9. The Proposed Transaction will be structured as follows:
a) The incorporation of New HoldCo;
b) The conclusion of a shareholders’ agreement to govern the shareholder rights in New
Holdco;
c) [✄];
d) [✄].
10. Pursuant to Clause 4 of the MOU, the proposed transaction is conditional upon inter alia receipt
of approval from the Office.
Legal Basis
11. In line with Article 14(1) of the MCCAA Act, the Office has the responsibility “to examine and
control concentrations between undertakings in terms of their effect on the structure of
competition on the market”. Indeed, in terms of Regulation 2 of the Regulations, the Office is
bound by law, to assess concentrations between undertakings having an aggregate turnover in
Malta exceeding EUR2,329,373.40 and each of the undertakings concerned accounting for at
least 10 percent of the combined aggregate turnover of the undertakings concerned.
12. In terms of Regulation 2 of the Regulations, the merging of two or more undertakings that were
previously independent from each other, constitutes a concentration within the meaning of the
Regulations. Therefore, the proposed transaction constitutes a concentration within the
meaning of these Regulations.
3

13. In accordance with Regulation 4 of the Regulations, it is the duty of the Director General of the
Office to determine and assess whether a concentration leads to a substantial lessening of
competition in the Maltese market.
14. The Proposed Transaction brings about the merger between Joinwell Limited, F.X.Borg
Furniture Limited, Econetique Limited and the Bath Concept Limited. Accordingly, the Office
considers the proposed transaction as constituting a concentration, and since the thresholds
are satisfied, the transaction is deemed notifiable in line with the Regulations.
Simplified Procedure
15. Following the examination of the notification, it is considered that the notified concentration
falls within the scope of Regulation 12(1) of the Regulations, whereby it is provided that:
“The simplified procedure will apply to the following categories of concentrations that are deemed
not to raise serious doubts as to their legality in terms of the provisions of these regulations…:
(iii) “two or more undertakings merge, or one or more undertakings acquire sole or joint control
of another undertaking and two or more of the parties to the concentration are engaged
in business activities either in the same product and geographical market and their combined
market share is less than 15% or in a product market which is upstream or downstream of a
product market in which any other party to the concentration is engaged and their combined
market share is less than 25%.”.
Assessment
16. Joinwell and FXB have a horizontal relationship given that both are actively present in the
business to consumer (B2C) retail sale of furniture, consisting mostly of kitchen, bedroom,
dining and living room furniture and also in the business to business (B2B) furniture market for
hotels, private hospitals, shops and offices.
17. The competition landscape of the B2C furniture sector is not expected to be affected by the
merger given that there are several brands available for customers and the market is
characterised by low barriers to entry and expansion for competitors. Indeed, several
competitors exist on the market selling imported or domestically produced products.
18. Thus, in the B2C retail furniture sector there are no affected markets even if the market had to
be segmented into the narrowest possible markets.
4

19. Similarly, in the case of the B2B retail furniture sector, the Parties have low combined market
shares which indicates that the Parties are not able to influence competition on the relevant
market. The Office does not consider the proposed transaction to lead to a substantial lessening
of competition within the meaning of the Regulations.
20. Thus, in the B2B sale of furniture, there is also no affected market.
21. Furthermore, the Office deems that given the low market share and the number of competitors
in the market, the merged company will not have the ability or incentive to profitably and
unilaterally raise its prices, worsen its quality or service, or reduce innovation efforts at one or
more of the pre-merger businesses.
22. Thus, the Office concludes that the proposed transaction will not lead to a substantial lessening
of competition and the Parties involved will continue to face strong competition in both the B2C
and B2B market sector.
Decision
23. In light of the above considerations, and in terms of Regulation 6(1)(ii) of the Control of
Concentrations Regulations, it is therefore decided:
a) That the Concentration falls within the scope of the Regulations on Control of
Concentrations;
b) That the Concentration does not raise serious doubts as to its lawfulness; and
c) Not to oppose the notified Concentration and to declare it is a lawful Concentration.
Godwin Mangion
Director General
